ops.body: Same controller repair follow-on: rows_saved still built a collection-wide ordering map when exactly one record in that collection was held. One record cannot reorder its writes. Count held rows and index only collections with more than one. Owner root. Acceptance: scalar and single-answer writes traverse zero collections; two-answer writes preserve insertion order with one traversal; independent merge/publication/install/source/unquarantine checks and organic measurement. Expanded existing real SQLite operation-count regression; no local load test or session/service signal. Next publication after the existing release batch window.
